scope: Official accession/version and exact DNA correspondence for all52 BASEL panel phages; no labels or training admission
roster: All52 prior phage IDs and unversioned accessions; no outcome-based removal or role-based selection
pilot_disclosure: Bas01, Bas12 and Bas14 official format pairs were inspected before this policy. Reuse their hash-bound saved payloads; fetch the remaining49 using the same accession-prefix routes.
comparison: Each official format must parse exactly one nonempty IUPAC DNA record with a versioned accession matching the requested accession root
Official annotation and FASTA must resolve the same accession version and identical upper-case nucleotide sequence
Authenticate original author GenBank container hash, require one record and exact upper-case DNA equality; custom record ID is not accession proof
No trimming, concatenation, reverse-complement/rotation search, sequence edits or nearest-reference replacement
failure: Retain every failed/mismatched source entry with its raw payload and explicit unresolved status; never substitute another sequence or add coverage
limits: Accession/reference DNA equality does not establish physical experimental-stock identity, matching protein annotations, relatedness clearance or prediction. No experimental construct is inferred.
